The '''3R heavy weapon tripod mount''' was a type of [[Tripod (weapon attachment)/Legends|tripod]] manufactured by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] and sold for 250 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The weapon attachment was available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
